question: In 1918, Mahatma Gandhi successfully led a strike of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mill workers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The strike led by Mahatma Gandhi **in 1918 was of **mill workers**.
 
• The strike was organized in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, against the oppressive working conditions, low wages, and increased working hours of the textile mill workers.
